lines.text: Isaiah tells the ships of Tarshish to wail because Tyre is laid waste, and word of it came from Cyprus.
Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, is told to be ashamed, and Egypt will writhe in agony at the news of Tyre.
The LORD of Hosts planned this to disgrace the renowned of the earth, and the Daughter of Tarshish must cultivate her land because no harbor remains.
The Virgin Daughter of Sidon is told to cross over to Lebanon, and the Philistines brought the land of the Chaldeans to ruin.
Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, then the LORD will restore her, and her profits will be set apart to the LORD.
